LocalizedUpdateText.title: LocalizedUpdateText
LocalizedUpdateText.description: Localized headline and release summary for a single supported language.

title.description: Localized headline of the update or announcement.

summary.description: Localized detailed release notes or announcement body.

UpdateTranslations.title: UpdateTranslations
UpdateTranslations.description: Optional dictionary of localized release notes keyed by supported language code.

AppUpdate.title: AppUpdate
AppUpdate.description: Official release notes, feature updates, and announcements for Complete Notebook.

title.description: Primary fallback headline of the update or announcement.

version.description: Application version tag such as 1.0.1+1 or v1.0.1+2.

summary.description: Primary fallback release notes or announcement body.

defaultLang.description: Primary language code used as default fallback for this release.

translations.description: Optional per-language map of localized titles and release notes.

playStoreUrl.description: Optional direct Google Play link for the release.

media.description: Optional list (max 4) of attached photos or videos for this release update.

pinned.description: Whether this announcement is pinned at the top of the feed.

published.description: Whether this announcement is publicly visible to global visitors.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the developer who published the update.

authorName.description: Public display name of the publisher (e.g. RyhStar Innovation).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the update was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the update was last modified.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Trusted administrator membership record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

grantedByUid.description: UID of the developer admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

UpdateMediaAttachment.title: UpdateMediaAttachment
UpdateMediaAttachment.description: Metadata pointer for an optional photo or video attached to a release update.

source.description: Storage origin: chunked Firestore asset or verified HTTPS external media URL.

mimeType.description: MIME type such as image/webp or video/mp4.

name.description: Original sanitized file name or media label.

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes (0 for external URL, up to 15728640 for uploaded files).

chunkCount.description: Number of stored binary chunks (0 for external URL, 1-50 for Firestore).

externalUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS URL when source is url, otherwise empty string.

UpdateMediaAsset.title: UpdateMediaAsset
UpdateMediaAsset.description: Parent metadata record for an uploaded photo or video linked to an AppUpdate document.

mimeType.description: Validated MIME type of the uploaded media.

name.description: Display filename of the uploaded media.

sizeBytes.description: Total encoded payload size in bytes (1 to 15728640).

chunkCount.description: Total number of sequential chunks stored in subcollection (1 to 50).

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the developer who uploaded the asset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the media metadata was created.

UpdateMediaChunk.title: UpdateMediaChunk
UpdateMediaChunk.description: Ordered base64 binary chunk of an uploaded photo or video asset.

updateId.description: Linked AppUpdate document ID for visibility gating.

index.description: Zero-based sequential chunk index matching document ID.

data.description: Base64 slice of the media binary payload (1 to 550000 chars).

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the developer who uploaded the chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chunk was uploaded.

/app_updates/{updateId}.description: Publicly readable (when published == true) official multilingual app changelogs and announcements managed exclusively by verified RyhStar Innovation admin.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted admin registry keyed by UID with zero PII fields.

/update_media/{mediaId}.description: Metadata records for optional uploaded photos and videos attached to app_updates.

/update_media/{mediaId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Chunked media payloads for uploaded photos and videos, strictly gated by parent AppUpdate publication state.
